items.name: DEDUPE
items.help: quarantine unmanaged duplicate files next to the arr-managed copy

items.name: DEDUPE_MAX
items.help: max duplicates quarantined per run

items.name: DEDUPE_MIN_RUNS
items.help: a duplicate must be seen this many runs first

items.name: REMEDIATE
items.help: quarantine a bad file and have the arr search again (needs REMEDIATE_CONFIRM in the container env for 'on')

items.name: REMEDIATE_CHECKS
items.help: which high/critical checks remediation acts on

items.name: REMEDIATE_MAX
items.help: max files re-grabbed per run

items.name: REMEDIATE_MIN_RUNS
items.help: finding must persist this many runs

items.name: REMEDIATE_MIN_AGE_HOURS
items.help: finding must be at least this old

items.name: REMEDIATE_FILE_MIN_AGE_HOURS
items.help: file must have been imported at least this long ago

items.name: REGRAB_WAIT_DAYS
items.help: if nothing is imported this many days after a re-grab, restore the original Show 324 the trash

items.name: ARR_RESCAN
items.help: ask the arr to rescan a series/movie whose media info is stale

items.name: PAPERCLIP
items.help: file one read-only Paperclip issue per day with new high findings

items.name: PAPERCLIP_MIN_SEVERITY
items.help: minimum severity handed to Paperclip

items.name: PLEX_REFRESH
items.help: tell Plex to rescan the folder after every file action

items.name: PLEX_CHECK
items.help: flag arr files that Plex has not indexed (PLEX_MISSING)

items.name: PLEX_MIN_AGE_HOURS
items.help: ignore files newer than this for PLEX_MISSING

items.name: MISSING_MIN_DAYS
items.help: flag monitored episodes/movies released at least this many days ago that still have no file (0 = off)

items.name: ANIME_ORIGINAL_AUDIO
items.help: flag anime files that have no Japanese (original-language) audio track as DUB_ONLY

items.name: AUTO_VERIFY
items.help: nightly: run the content check on new runtime/title findings (max AUTO_VERIFY_MAX per night)

items.name: AUTO_VERIFY_MAX
items.help: max content checks queued per night

items.name: AUTO_WHISPER
items.help: nightly: queue AI subtitles for files Bazarr has found nothing for in AUTO_WHISPER_DAYS days (NO_SUBS / UND_AUDIO_NO_SUBS; max AUTO_WHISPER_MAX per night)

items.name: AUTO_WHISPER_MAX
items.help: max AI-subtitle jobs queued per night

items.name: AUTO_WHISPER_DAYS
items.help: days a no-subtitles finding must stay open before AI subtitles are queued

items.name: AUTO_ACCEPTLANG
items.help: nightly: when every file of a season is in one language the arr did not expect, tag the title audit-lang-xxx (same as the accept-language button)

items.name: AUTO_ACCEPTLANG_MIN_FILES
items.help: a season needs at least this many files, all in the same language, before it is accepted automatically

items.name: AUTO_FIXHEADER
items.help: nightly: repair files whose container length lies (lossless remux, original to trash; max 10 per night)

items.name: SUBTAG
items.help: nightly: sniff untagged embedded subtitle tracks and write the language tag (mkv only, English/Japanese/Russian detected Show 324 the text)

items.name: SUBTAG_MAX
items.help: max files sub-tagged per run

items.name: TRASH_DAYS
items.help: keep re-grabbed/orphan files in the trash this many days

items.name: TRASH_DAYS_ARCHIVE
items.help: keep archived (watched & cold) seasons in the trash this many days

items.name: TRACK_PREFS
items.help: nightly: set default audio/subtitle flags in MKVs (anime -> Japanese/original audio, else English; English subs) and Plex's remembered selection

items.name: TRACK_PREFS_MAX
items.help: max files whose MKV default flags are rewritten per night

items.name: PLEX_SELECT_MAX
items.help: max Plex items whose selected audio/subtitle stream is set per night

items.name: WATCH_STATS
items.help: nightly: combine Tautulli plays, Plex watched counts and file sizes into the Space tab

items.name: COLD_DAYS
items.help: a fully watched season counts as cold when nobody played it for this many days

items.name: NEVER_WATCHED_DAYS
items.help: never-played titles are listed once they are this old

items.name: SPACE_MIN_GB
items.help: ignore seasons/movies smaller than this in the Space tab

items.name: TRASH_DAYS_DEDUPE
items.help: keep duplicates in the trash this many days

items.name: PREFERRED_AUDIO
items.help: audio languages that are always acceptable (ISO 639-2)

items.name: PREFERRED_SUBS
items.help: subtitle languages that count as 'has subs'

items.name: NTFY_MIN_SEVERITY
items.help: push a notification for new findings at or above this severity

items.name: STALE_HOURS
items.help: /health reports 503 when the last run is older than this
